title: Cross-agent broker task
description: Input contract for `scripts/agent_broker.py run --task-file <this>`. See .agents/protocol/v1/worker-policy.md for the invariants this contract exists to enforce.

task_id.description: Unique identifier. Used as the dedicated worktree's directory name and as the git branch suffix (agent-broker/<task_id>), so it must be filesystem- and branch-name-safe.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to any existing checkout (main or a worktree) of the repository the task should branch from. The broker creates a brand new dedicated linked worktree from this repo -- it never runs the task directly in `repo_path` itself.

base_ref.description: Git ref the new dedicated worktree's branch is created from.

prompt.description: Task instructions handed to the agent verbatim (after the harness prepends its anti-recursion guard).

fallback_agent.description: Agent to fall back to if `primary_agent` fails with a recognized quota/auth/service-unavailable signal AND leaves the worktree clean. Defaults to the agent other than `primary_agent`. 'none' disables fallback entirely for this task.

mode.description: 'read_only' runs the agent in a no-edits/plan-equivalent mode (Claude: --permission-mode plan; Codex: --sandbox read-only). 'write' allows file edits within the dedicated worktree only.

primary_model.description: Optional model override passed to the primary agent's CLI.

fallback_model.description: Optional model override passed to the fallback agent's CLI, if a fallback occurs.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock timeout applied independently to each attempt (primary, and fallback if triggered).
